title: Moving from the Bert Wheeler Theater to the Mercury Theater
summary: The show moved from the Bert Wheeler Theater to a larger Mercury Theater house on 13th Street for more seating, having run from about 1968 to 1969.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: I'm not sure I understand. Did the show move from one place to another?
Yes, sir. It moved from the Bert Wheeler Theater to the House of the Mercury on 13th Street.
For seating capacity. To please the larger, you know. And it would have more accomodations. Of course, they had set a record again, you see.
How long was it at the Bert Wheeler Theater?
Oh, it was there from about '68 up until '69, you see.
So, all of you were performing together for that whole period of time?
Yes. Yes. Yeah. Except the ones that went with the Olympics, you see. They went away with the Olympics, see, just before we moved away.
